'''Optical Information Crystals''' were a type of [[Data crystal/Legends|data crystals]] that was designed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to hide important information from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:Optical_Information_Crystal.png|220px|left|thumb|A crystal inside the Jawa Data Crystal Information Area]]

Those crystals could be activated by shining a powerful light beam onto them through the means of a [[laser light generator]]. Additionally, a large tilting [[Mirror/Legends|mirror]] was needed to redirect the laser beam onto the crystal properly.<ref name="DW" />

==History==
The technology of the Optical Information Crystals was invented during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a number of Optical Information Crystals had fallen into the hands of the [[Nkik clan]] of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], who kept them in a [[Jawa Data Crystal Information Area|stronghold]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], under the watchful [[Eye/Legends|eye]] of [[Keemee]].<ref name="DW" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''
